notes: UriTemplate.expand(template, vars). Not passing: one example of the RFC, X{.keys*}, comes out with commas between the pairs instead of dots.
details: RFC 6570 section 3.2.5 gives X{.keys*} as X.semi=%3B.dot=..comma=%2C; version 23.4.0 returns X.semi=%3B,dot=.,comma=%2C. The other 159 fixtures pass. The package has no option that changes this, so there is no variant.
